operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) There is established the National Productivity Advisory Committee. The Committee shall be composed of distinguished citizens appointed by the President, only one of whom may be a full-time officer or employee of the Federal Government.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 246944; common-crawl capture 2025-09-07T00:27:52Z; Sec. 1(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) The President shall designate a Chairman from among the members of the Committee.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 246944; common-crawl capture 2025-09-07T00:27:52Z; Sec. 1(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) The Committee shall advise the President and the Secretary of the Treasury through the Cabinet Council on Economic Affairs on the Federal Government's role in achieving higher levels of national productivity and economic growth.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 246944; common-crawl capture 2025-09-07T00:27:52Z; Sec. 2(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) The Committee shall advise the President, the Secretary of the Treasury and the President's Task Force on Regulatory Relief with respect to the potential impact on national productivity of Federal laws and regulations.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 246944; common-crawl capture 2025-09-07T00:27:52Z; Sec. 2(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (c) The Committee shall advise and work closely with the Cabinet Council on Economic Affairs (composed of the Secretaries of the Treasury, State, Commerce, Labor, and Transportation, the United States Trade Representative, the Chairman of the Council of Economic Advisers, and the Director of the Office of Management and Budget), the Assistant to the President for Policy Development, and other governmental offices the President may deem appropriate.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 246944; common-crawl capture 2025-09-07T00:27:52Z; Sec. 2(c)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (d) In the performance of its advisory duties, the Committee shall conduct a continuing review and assessment of national productivity and shall advise the Secretary of the Treasury and the Cabinet Council on Economic Affairs.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 246944; common-crawl capture 2025-09-07T00:27:52Z; Sec. 2(d)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) The heads of Executive agencies shall, to the extent permitted by law, provide the Committee such information with respect to productivity as it may require for the purpose of carrying out its functions.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 246944; common-crawl capture 2025-09-07T00:27:52Z; Sec. 3(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) Members of the Committee shall serve without compensation for their work on the Committee. However, members of the Committee who are not full-time officers or employees of the Federal Government shall be entitled to travel expenses, including per diem in lieu of subsistence, as authorized by law for persons serving intermittently in government service (5 U.S.C. 5701-5707).

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 246944; common-crawl capture 2025-09-07T00:27:52Z; Sec. 3(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (c) Any administrative support or other expenses of the Committee shall be paid, to the extent permitted by law, from funds available for the expenses of the Department of the Treasury.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 246944; common-crawl capture 2025-09-07T00:27:52Z; Sec. 3(c)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (d) The Executive Secretary of the Cabinet Council on Economic Affairs shall serve as the Executive Secretary to the National Productivity Advisory Committee.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 246944; common-crawl capture 2025-09-07T00:27:52Z; Sec. 3(d)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) Notwithstanding any other Executive Order, the responsibilities of the President under the Federal Advisory Committee Act, as amended, except that of reporting annually to the Congress, which are applicable to the advisory committee established by this Order, shall be performed by the Secretary of the Treasury in accordance with guidelines and procedures established by the Administrator of General Services.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 246944; common-crawl capture 2025-09-07T00:27:52Z; Sec. 4(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) The Committee shall terminate on December 31,1982, unless sooner extended.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 246944; common-crawl capture 2025-09-07T00:27:52Z; Sec. 4(b)
